sentences.span: Has the No. 1 spot overall among free apps on the Apple U.S in just over a week after its September 8 release
sentences.why: Source (and the duplicate at 17384__what-matters-today-hf-pain-continues-muse.txt) says Muse reached #1 'just over a week' after its Sept 8 release — more than a week. The sentence flips this to 'within a week,' the opposite direction (under a week). The AI-vs-habit-stock framing in the second half is faithfully drawn from 17392's 'Watch the CPU/cloud compute trade' plus 17513's Consumer Inertia basket (switching-cost names being shorted), so only the timing clause is distorted.

sentences.span: the VIX® Index ending the week at 14.8% (7th percentile low)
sentences.why: The 14.27 close is real (Goldman's 17513 desk note) and the skew move (58th to 29th percentile) is verbatim from this same Cboe file. But the '7th percentile' stat in the source is computed for a different value on a different day — the prior week's 14.8 close — not for 14.27. No Cboe document in the source set assigns a percentile to 14.27 specifically; the sentence presents the borrowed stat as if Cboe verified it for that exact print.
